facts.fact: La Nation reports that the national e-Foncier platform has been operational since 1 January 2025 with the active participation of town halls (mairies), notaries and surveyors, in a cadastre reform covering 12 communes and 32 arrondissements with 491,420 parcels registered, as presented by the land agency ANDF; the article does not say that town hall staff work in it from their own offices, nor how those offices are connected.
facts.system: Connection used by town halls for the e-Foncier platform
